name: Garden City
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Garden City for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the Santaland Parade) through December 19 (Breakfast with Santa), with Santa at the Straight Farmhouse (December 5), Kiwanis and Rotary Selfies with Santa (December 5) and the Elf Workshop (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Garden City

  • 5 Christmas events for Garden City families
  • 2 free events: the Santaland Parade and Selfies with Santa at Barson's Greenhouse
  • Meet Santa: Straight Farmhouse December 5, Selfies December 5, Breakfast with Santa December 19
  • Parades and tree lightings: the 65th Santaland Parade on November 28
  • Season: November 28 to December 19, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Garden City families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit, Wayne County LightFest and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
